properties.name: Golden Gate
properties.desc: The strongest currents in the Bay (4–6 kn on a big ebb). Ocean swell meets the Bay, and when the afternoon westerly blows against an ebb, waves get steep and confused. Not a beginner area.

properties.name: The Slot
properties.desc: From the Gate past Alcatraz toward Berkeley. The summer afternoon sea breeze funnels through here: 20–25+ knots is common. It's also where the main ship traffic lanes run.

properties.name: Raccoon Strait
properties.desc: Narrow passage between Tiburon and Angel Island. Current runs hard here.

properties.name: Around Alcatraz
properties.desc: Strong currents and eddies swirl around the island, and ship lanes pass on both sides.

properties.name: Point Blunt (Angel Island)
properties.desc: Current accelerates around the point, and it's exposed to the afternoon wind.

properties.name: Bay Bridge & Yerba Buena Island
properties.desc: Current swirls around the bridge towers and the island. Ships turn here for Oakland, and ferries converge on the Ferry Building.

properties.name: Southern waterfront
properties.desc: South of the Bay Bridge along the city shore. Usually less wind than the Slot, especially in the morning, but there's still current, ferries (Oracle Park and Chase Center on event days), and ships at Anchorage 8A.

properties.name: McCovey Cove / China Basin
properties.desc: Protected water right next to Pier 40. Calm, but full of kayaks and small boats on game days.

properties.name: Clipper Cove
properties.desc: Small, protected cove between Treasure Island and Yerba Buena Island, and a popular anchorage. It's shallow near the edges and at the entrance, so stay in the middle and watch the depth.

properties.name: Aquatic Park
properties.desc: Enclosed by a curved breakwater. Calm, but there are swimmers: go dead slow and give them room.

properties.name: Richardson Bay
properties.desc: Sheltered from the ocean swell, with lighter wind than the Slot. It's shallow outside the marked channel, and there are no-wake zones near Sausalito.

properties.name: Oakland Estuary
properties.desc: A long, protected channel between Oakland and Alameda: flat water. Watch for ferries, and ships near the west end.
